subject: Backing up game saves
author: Xandu
body:
Backing up game saves is no problem as long as you have a secondary storage device like the Xbox 360 memory card.

The problem with the game saves for Burnout 3 is that Burnout 3 is a original XBox game and most game saves are hardware locked which means that backups are worthless if your xbox gets repaired or replaced. Luckily this strategy was abandoned on the Xbox 360 (for XBOX 360 games) and save games are now locked to gamertag and NOT the hardware you played on.

Originally there was no lock at all on the 360  but after a couple of people had achieved gamerscores of 100K ++ from downloading savegames of a website Microsoft realized that this was a major problem and locked savegames to gamertags.

-- The Creator --
